description: This file defines the 'CalendarViewQuickEdit' class, which manages the quick edit view of calendar entries within a SuiteCRM module. It handles access permissions, prepares the editing form with reminders data, and outputs a JSON response containing the form HTML and related data.

classes.name: CalendarViewQuickEdit
classes.description: A class extending SugarView to provide quick edit functionality for calendar records in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares access permissions and initializes the 'editable' flag based on current user's privileges.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Loads necessary modules, prepares the edit view, gathers reminders data, and outputs a JSON-encoded response containing the form HTML and related data.
